_comment: FIELD54 Stage A (research/experiments/FIELD54_NATIVE_PLAN_2026-10-29.md, record FIELD54_COVARIATES_2026-10-29.md): covariates rebuilt natively at 54 km from the RAW sources. Needs env HOUFIN_DATA54 = a separate data root holding symlinks to the raw source dirs (LUH3, hyde35, HBUI, soilgrids_5000m, dem, land_source), ref_grid_54km.tif and land_mask/ocean_mask_54km.tif (copies of processed/grid54). Same box/origin as 27 km; 67 x 112 cells, each exactly 2 x 2 27 km children. Fine factors are RELATIVE to the ref grid, so doubling them keeps the 27 km sub-cell lattice: elevation 15 -> 30 (1.8 km), BUI 27 -> 54 (1 km). LUH-3 per-parent rates are aggregated as parent-area-weighted means (opt-in switch, see src/data/preprocess/luh3.py).

luh3._parent_weighted_comment: Per-unit-of-parent rates (netCDF long_name/units): fertl_X kg/ha of crop X; irrig_X irrigated fraction of crop X; fharv_cXper fraction of crop cXper biomass harvested; flood flooded fraction of c3ann; prtct_Y protected fraction of land use Y; pltns_wdprd fraction of harvested plantation biomass (parent proxy: plantation area, the only available measure); secma/secmb mean age / biomass density of secondary land (secdf+secdn). Parent area = sum of the listed fractions.
